attempts.summary: Deployed an Ansible playbook from node3 (the only node with ansible preinstalled, used as control node) that installs and configures dnsmasq on node1 to resolve inventory-api.internal to node2's IP, and configures node2's systemd-resolved to use node1 as its DNS server for the ~internal domain. Verified internal resolution works and external resolution (e.g. google.com) is unaffected. Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol on all three nodes: each was rebooted individually, its boot_id was proven to change, and post-reboot health/recovery was directly verified (dnsmasq active and listening, DNS config persisted, inventory-api.internal still resolving on node2, and a re-run of the playbook after node3's own reboot was fully idempotent with changed=0).
